components.role: GPT models serve as language model backbones that generate code and reasoning traces.
Arithmetic reasoning tasks test the model's ability to solve mathematical problems and perform multi-step numerical calculations.
Code generation tasks require producing executable or structured code snippets, such as CAD code.

target_task.text: The combination targets domains involving both arithmetic reasoning and code generation, such as CAD code generation.

limitation.text: Language models often struggle to ensure that multi-step plans align with high-level user intent and satisfy symbolic constraints in complex domains.

combination.text: The framework integrates reasoning representations into a search process to actively focus exploration toward feasible and meaningful plans, improving performance in arithmetic reasoning and code generation domains.

target_user.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Software developers, engineers, and quantitative analysts who require automated multi-step planning and code synthesis.

jtbd.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: When building complex systems or performing calculations, users need to generate reliable code and solve arithmetic problems without violating symbolic constraints or user intent.

value_prop.text: No evidence in the bundle; hypothesis to test: Structured reasoning representations actively guide search to produce higher-accuracy, constraint-aligned plans and code.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is designated as axis V (viability) due to missing evidence in the bundle. It is assumed that enterprise users are willing to pay for a constrained reasoning framework embedded in code generation workflows.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and price acceptance tests presenting mock-ups of the constrained reasoning framework to evaluate willingness to pay and feature demand under a proposed threshold of 500 dollars per month.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 40 percent positive willingness-to-pay responses during customer price acceptance interviews.

kill_criteria.text: Less than a proposed threshold of 10 percent of interviewed prospects express interest in adopting the paid workflow.

open_source.use: Serves as a large language model series backbone for generating text and code.
Provides thinking and reasoning capabilities for language models.
Provides GUI world models via renderable code generation.
Provides an environment for app-based tasks and evaluation.
Provides command-line utilities for prompt iteration.
Provides neural network modules in PyTorch.

to_build.text: A specialized Monte Carlo Tree Search wrapper implementing intent-constraint pairs to guide exploration.
